candidates.claim: Trunks sw-core-01 Gi1/0/22 (allowed VLANs 10,99) and Gi1/0/24 (allowed VLANs 10,20,30,99) carry VLAN 10, although the registry says only OT-facing ports may be active in VLAN 10.
candidates.remediation: Confirm whether VLAN 10 transport over these DMZ-core trunks is intended; if so, record it as an exception to the OT-facing-only VLAN 10 rule.

candidates.claim: rtr-01 EDGE_IN permits tcp/443 from any source to 203.0.113.2, the outside address of fw-01, so HTTPS toward the firewall is reachable from the Internet, although the management policy allows HTTPS/ASDM only from MGMT on the fw-01 mgmt interface.
candidates.remediation: Remove or narrow the rtr-01 EDGE_IN entry at seq 40 so that no Internet source can reach HTTPS on fw-01's outside address.

candidates.claim: sw-it-01 has an ntp server 10.10.20.6 line that is not in the approved baseline (baseline delta: added).
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the deviation: approve or remove the ntp server 10.10.20.6 line on sw-it-01.

candidates.claim: sw-it-01, whose management address 10.10.99.13 is in MGMT, is configured to use DMZ address 10.10.20.6 as an NTP server, which is not the approved MGMT-to-DMZ NTP service (10.10.20.5 only).
candidates.remediation: Confirm the authorized time source; if 10.10.20.6 is not approved, point sw-it-01 to 10.10.20.5 and remove the 10.10.20.6 line.

clarifications.question: The registry says only OT-facing ports may be active in VLAN 10, but the approved trunk sets allow VLAN 10 on sw-core-01 Gi1/0/22 and Gi1/0/24. Is VLAN 10 transport over these DMZ-core trunks intended (for example, transit to the fw-01 OT subinterface), and should it be treated as an exception to the OT-facing-only rule?

sw-it-01 is configured with NTP server 10.10.20.6, a DMZ address that is not listed in the zone registry (only 10.10.20.5 is the approved NTP service for OT and MGMT). Is 10.10.20.6 an authorized time source for sw-it-01, and if so, should it be added to the approved services?
